trigger.condition: The five blowdown files contain 1 kHz MFM and tank channels with approximately one million adjacent electronic samples per case.
trigger.observed_issue: A pointwise CoolProp real-gas throat optimization over roughly five million electronically autocorrelated samples did not complete within the interactive validation window.

frozen_sampling_rule.rule: After synchronizing finite post-release MFM.mfr, Tank.p and Tank.T samples, compute non-overlapping one-second arithmetic means by floor(MFM.time - MFM.t0).
frozen_sampling_rule.then_apply_original_window: Apply the original pressure screen and the 10% of measured peak screen to the one-second series.
frozen_sampling_rule.rationale: One-second block means reduce electronic autocorrelation and pseudoreplication while retaining the full blowdown time span and all raw samples in deterministic blocks.
